notes.title: 2024/01/04 Update (Added Retry Feature for Progress Stalls and Save Points, etc.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A restart function has been implemented for when progress becomes impossible. By pressing the ESC key and then pressing the 0 key within 10 seconds, you can restart from the living room. While there is an introduction sequence, no flags are reset, so if you encounter this issue, feel free to try this feature.
[*] Currently, we are aware of a bug where the game occasionally becomes unresponsive when heading toward the bedroom. In such cases, please also try this restart feature.
[*] The game has been updated to save progress after heading to the bedroom in the "Winter Night" stage.
[*] A bug where the player would become stuck and unresponsive after jumping on a cardboard box and forcing their way behind the TV in the "Autumn" stage has been fixed.
[*] Additionally, a different patch has been applied to address the issue where the .exe file cannot be found when launching the game from Steam.
[*] Various other improvements have been made, including enhancements to objects with poor sensitivity for interaction.
[/list]
We apologize to those who experienced progress stalls or freezes. We will continue to make improvements, and we appreciate your ongoing support.
